name: Martin
bio: The name Martin appears in the Cow Boy for several different men: one who tracked stolen horses in April 1884, the father-in-law who ran a doctor's drug store in Medora in late 1884, a Black Hills legislator who supported the 1885 fence law, a man who panned gold up the river with Keeler in 1885, and an editor of the Montana Democrat at Miles City in 1886. Nothing in the excerpts shows that any two of these are the same person.
